PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Rainbow Six style leaning on foot: hold Q or E to lean round corners and shoot
PluginData.Description:
Lean left and right on foot, Rainbow Six style. Hold Q or E.
- A real side-step, so the server and other players see you lean out. Your hitbox and gun move with you and shots go where you aim. - The camera and gun tilt with the lean. The aim point stays put. - Stops at walls. Let go and you step back to where you started. - Walk sideways while holding the lean to keep it. Letting go always straightens you up. - Works standing, crouching, through jumps and on moving ships.
Works offline, hosted and on dedicated servers. Client-side only. It just presses strafe for you, so it can do nothing that tapping A and D cannot.
Off in jetpack, on ladders, in seats and on remote controls, turrets and cameras. Q and E keep their vanilla roll there.
Settings: keys (with Ctrl, Alt or Shift), hold or toggle, lean distance (0.2 to 0.8 m), camera tilt (0 to 20 degrees).
Documentation and source: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsADSLean
Bugs: open a GitHub issue with your Pulsar info.log.
